## Description and Rationale

I am a data engineer based in Vilnius, Lithuania, registering as an
independent participant. My day to day work is building data pipelines
and working with APIs over large operational datasets, and I hold a
degree in IT.

I registered because taxi-out time is the kind of problem I like working
on: a clearly defined regression target on real operational data, with
enough structure in the movement records, and in the open weather and
flow management data the challenge allows, that the modelling choices
actually matter. Most public datasets available to practise on are
either toy sized or long since solved. This one is neither, and it is
scored on a held out period rather than a random split, which makes the
evaluation honest.

I intend to publish my code and documentation in a public repository
whatever my final placing, and to write up the method if the result
turns out to be worth reading.
